text:
I'm sorry, but you're not eligible for a refund. Leafy Plus is only fully refundable if it's cancelled within 14 days of purchase or renewal and no benefits have been used. You're at 20 days and have used free shipping, so neither condition is met.

You can still cancel, but no refund would be issued. Your benefits (free Standard shipping, free change-of-mind returns, the 90-day guarantee, and 10% member pricing on pots and accessories) would continue until the end of your paid year. The policy excerpts don't cover how to cancel Leafy Plus or any exceptions to this rule. If you'd like, I can escalate your case to a Support Lead to review.
